rule_or_requirement: A faster launch must preserve a pixel-only finite three-action package and retain the qualified-finish objective.
observable_information: Four grayscale observation frames, pixel speed, visible road centers and inherited pixel-driver action; no simulator state at inference.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Keep exact one-shot launch and inherited early steering at pixel speed at most 45; above 45 return inherited guard action without anticipatory steering.
expected_success_endpoint: One immutable local ZIP containing the single high-speed preview gate while retaining opening launch.
falsifier: Package mismatch, forbidden content, missing wrapper, or changed base action outside the preview gate.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Build one exact local ZIP and compare against exact launch-only ZIP on registered cells.
resource_and_risk_gate: Local packaging profile with a 600-second limit and 500 MB ZIP limit; no driving, training, site upload, official submission, or model confirmation in this run.
